sources_audited: startmate.com — 'What we look for in startups' (2025-02)
ycombinator.com — Application Q's + Paul Graham essays (1980s-2024)

entries.criterion: Founder has previously built / shipped a product
entries.description: Antler explicitly looks for 'have previously built/hacked something together'. Even a side project that 100 people used is signal.
evidence_required: Ship history list in founder profile
tactic: Include one line per prior product in your About page

entries.criterion: Founder has a unique connection or insight to the problem
entries.description: Antler weights 'insider insight' heavily — domain experience > generalists. Ex-employer brand-names amplify.
tactic: Fill in years_in_domain + domain_insight in founder profile
Open the pitch with a 30-second insider story

entries.criterion: Things are happening fast (customer interviews, users, revenue, partnerships)
entries.description: Antler measures velocity — what shipped this week vs last week. Even pre-revenue, 10 customer calls > 0.
tactic: Connect analytics for live engagement signal

entries.criterion: Founders have invented new tech or made a significant technical leap
entries.description: Antler weights invention especially for deep-tech / AI / hardware. Patents are signal, not requirement.
tactic: Publish a 'how it works' tech blog
File provisional patent if novel method

entries.criterion: Founders articulate scale, severity, and a believable roadmap
entries.description: Antler wants a 'category-defining' framing, not 'we're 10% better'. Quantify the problem in dollars + lives.
tactic: Pin a one-pager vision doc to data room
Quantify TAM × penetration on landing page

entries.description: Antler tests for 10× on speed / cost / ease / quality. One dimension is enough — pick the most defensible one.

entries.criterion: AUD $1K+ MRR with 4+ weeks of growth
entries.description: Startmate's Seed program looks for early revenue traction. Even tiny MRR ≥ 0 disrupts the conversation.
tactic: Send weekly growth update to investors

entries.criterion: Co-founding team with complementary skills (CEO + CTO + ideally Design)
entries.description: Startmate prefers 2-3 person founding teams. Solo founders are accepted but face higher bar.
Startmate funds AU/NZ companies but wants global ambition. AU-only narrative weakens the pitch.
tactic: Frame TAM as global, SOM as AU

entries.criterion: B2B SaaS focus — annual contract value > $5K
entries.description: Startmate Seed leans B2B SaaS. Consumer / hardware accepted but smaller cheques.
YC canon — manually onboard early users, ship hourly, talk to customers daily. Hand-crafted growth is signal.
tactic: Reply to every support ticket personally

entries.description: YC's most-used phrase. They want founders who find a way around every blocker without asking permission.
evidence_required: Story of unblocking a major obstacle
tactic: Open pitch with one resourcefulness story
Show specific things shipped on $0 budget

entries.description: YC's slogan. Retention > acquisition. Product-market fit is binary — they can feel it from the metrics.

entries.criterion: Why you, why now, why this
entries.description: YC's pitch frame. Why are you the right founders? Why is now the right moment? Why this approach?
tactic: Open every investor meeting with it

entries.criterion: Mentor whisperer — actively recruits and listens to mentors
entries.description: Techstars' Mentor Magic — accelerator selects founders who lean into mentorship, not those who already know everything.
Techstars vertical programs (sports, energy, fintech) prioritise founders who fit the corporate partner's roadmap.
Techstars cohort discipline relies on weekly metrics review. Founders without measurement get cut from later rounds.
tactic: Publish Q3 OKRs to data room

entries.criterion: Defensible IP — patent, trade secret, or significant data moat
entries.description: SkyDeck (Berkeley) skews deep tech / AI / biotech. They weight IP defensibility heavily.
SkyDeck favours research-grade technical depth — PhD or equivalent ship history.

entries.criterion: University-affiliated IP — Melbourne Uni or research-spinout
entries.description: MVi prefers founders linked to MU research. Non-uni founders accepted but weighted lower.
tactic: Show transition from research to commercial

entries.description: Cicada Innovations (Sydney) deep tech focus — hardware + regulated industries. TGA / ARTG / patents matter.
Blackbird targets $1B+ outcomes — local-only theses don't fit their portfolio model.

entries.criterion: Founder-market fit — irreplaceable for this exact problem
entries.description: Blackbird's 'why you' bar — founders should be the only people in AU obviously suited to solve this.
Blackbird measures founders by what they learned this week from customers vs last week. Velocity of insight > shipped features.
YC requires founders sign equity agreement with standard 4yr / 1yr cliff before Demo Day.
Techstars cohort founders send a monthly update to mentors + investors. Compounds trust + network effect.

entries.criterion: AU corporate structure with ABN + ASIC
entries.description: Startmate requires AU pty ltd structure before investment. Pre-incorporation OK to apply, must incorporate before signing.
Antler advises founders to create 10-15% ESOP pool before signing term sheets to avoid post-money dilution.
YC pitch standard — one metric, 30-day chart, growth visible. Doesn't matter which metric, as long as it's growing.
Blackbird looks for retention shape — flat after week 4 means PMF, decay means more work. They prefer flat.
